notes.title: Bug fixes and more optimisation
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 

We hope you are having a nice day !

A new bug fixes and optimisation update has been pushed.

[i][b]General[/b][/i]
- Another attempt to fix a bug where some players crashes when launching the game
- Optimized some models and materials use which should improve performance
- Optimized some textures which should improve memory usage
- Fixed some of the characters' model bug when dying 
- More code optimisation

[i][b]VR[/b][/i]
- When going out of a vehicle, the camera stays at the same height and won't go on the ground anymore
- Fix the bug where players could not enter a vehicle after choosing the Open World mode

Unless some players encounter game breaking bugs, we will work on a Daily Quest System starting next week.

If you experience crashes, please share with us your logs in DMs or in #bug-report, that'd be very helpful ! You can find them in C:/Users/YOUR_USERNAME/AppData/Local/Temp/Raptor Lab/GangV/Crashes

We are still trying to post more about GangV on our social medias and its development until its release, we would be very thankful to receive your support on these platforms <3
https://twitter.com/raptor_lab/
https://www.instagram.com/raptor_lab/

[b]
Also, any content or post you make on our games on Twitter or Insta will be reposted, so feel free to @ us so we can see it : )[/b]

Thank you very much for following GangV !

notes.title: Optimisation & Character Rework Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone ,

We hope you are doing well 🙂 

The new [i][b]Optimisation & Character Rework Update[/b][/i] has been pushed:

[list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38336796/fa1b35a7a0d69bce073bdd2b7126f5ce654fed21.png[/img]
[*] Reduced the memory usage by 2GB more (we'll keep on going!)

Among the new Characters, we're very happy to introduce some of them to you, because they are based on our GangV players 😄

It was a pleasure to discuss with them to create their characters and we hope you will like them 😃 

Also, we are trying to relaunch our social medias and to post more about GangV and its development until its release, we would be very thankful to receive your support on these platforms 💜 
https://twitter.com/raptor_lab/
https://www.instagram.com/raptor_lab/

notes.title: Patch Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

A new patch update for GangV focused on VR has been released with the following changes:

[i][b]VR[/b][/i]
- Fixed a bug where sometimes we could not enter a vehicle
- Fixed a bug where a new weapon is always spawned whenever we exit the menu: now it will be spawned after you exit the menu (if you have clicked on the Spawn button), on your right holster
We might rework this spawning system later but for the moment this could be used as a a temporary fix
- Fixed LODs of all characters so that we could see them from further (can be adjusted but we need to see if it affects performance)

[i][b]General[/b][/i]
- Fixed some map bugs
- Fixed a bug where money is not reset in Battle Royale
- (Optimization) Fixed and removed lots of warning messages which might increase performance
- (Optimization) Optimize Radios in vehicle, now we are using Radio templates and only one radio is generated per player which might also increase performance
- General other code optimization has been made
- Fixed the bug where bots not spawning in BR 
- Attempt to fix the walking pedestrians at 90 degrees bug but we're not totally sure if it really works. Any feedback if you still encounter it would be greatly appreciated 🙂 

Thanks for playing GangV and take care !

notes.title: Multiplayer mods update
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We hope you're doing well 🙂 
An important update has been made on GangV!

🛠️  MODDING 🛠️ 
Modding is now available ! The Steam Workshop is now open for @Modder to create awesome content !
You will find a great guide here: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2525092045
Templates for vehicles and weapons can be found in the game's installation folder. They are uploaded on the workshop for some of you who want to try them.
We can't wait to see what you're going to create !

🔧CHANGES 🔧
[list]
[*] Reduced pop-up frequency in VR
[*] Increased VR movement speed
[/list]

🩹  BUG FIXES 🩹 
[list]
[*] Console commands should now work properly in modded servers
[*] Fixed bug where bots are not shooting in Battle Royale
[*] Purge Night elements should be removed, the event system and top 3 players of the event remain
[*] Reworked and put the jump back in VR
[*] Fixed the bug where our character in VR can't go through doors
[*] Reworked the Climb feature + hands animation: you will see if your hands are grabbing the surface (meaning that you can pull yourself up)
[*] Rewrite the code of the PROLocomotion, adjusted its speed 
[*] Code optimization in general (we'd be happy to receive feedback about performance, there is still a long way to go)
[*] Fixed the bug when holding a weapon can kill ourselves when in OpenPVP mode (when you are with other players)
[*] Fixed Police and Wanted level not working in Battle Royale
[*] Fixed bug of VR Character animation not playing when moving
[*] Fixed the bug where we can kill NPCs while running through them or when taking a weapon in PC
[*] Fixed the skin color bug of the waitress (Amy) when dying
[*] Fixed the weird rotation of NPCs in vehicles
[/list]

If some of you are experiencing crashes, please send us your crash logs in bug-report or in DMs. You will find them in C:/Users/%username%/AppData/Local/Temp/Raptor Lab/GangV/Crashes

Thanks for playing GangV!

notes.title: S E A S O N 2 : P U R G E N I G H T S
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We are excited to announce the beginning of the [b]Season 2: PURGE NIGHTS[/b] coming on GangV today ! 💀 

Let us introduce you to:

[i][b]The Purge Nights Mode[/b][/i]
It's a new game mode coming TWICE a week ! It replaces the Battle Royale and you will get 2X your money earned if you play during this event.

The Battle Royale will always happen during the night.
There will be no police but everyone you meet might react in an unpredictable way when they see you ! You might frighten them but they might also get aggressive and start shooting at you and everyone else 🔫 

Your enemies won't appear anymore on the map, and the battle will always end up in the town, and with the increased number of people in the town and the chaotic atmosphere, you will be able to hide among the crowd 💀 

[i][b]New Leaderboards for Season & Event [/b][/i]
The leaderboard of the new season was reset to allow everyone to reach the top. The best 3 winners of the last Purge Nights Event will be shown at the start of the game 🏆 

[i][b]A New Vehicle: The Freedom ![/b][/i]
A new vehicle has been added to this season ! It's the best one for off-road, with great conductivity to provide you an awesome feeling of 🆓 DOM ! 

[i][b]The Monster Fair[/b][/i]
With the arrival of this new point of interest, you will be able to discover the Freedom and many others in the car exhibition 🚙 🚗 

[i][b]New skins & music[/b][/i]
To complete this dark season, new skin elements and music have been added as well 🤡

Thanks for playing GangV and see you soon in the game !

notes.title: Modding beta is open !
notes.content:
Hello !

We're happy to announce the opening of the modding beta !

The modding system allows you to create custom weapons, vehicles and even edit the map. More is planned to be added in futures updates.
Using the game engine Unity, you have all the needed tools to create your own experience :D
No coding required ! Unity is very intuitive and with the modding template inculded in the game's installation files you can quickly start modding !
A [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2525092045]Steam guide[/url] is also available detailing everything about modding GangV.

Currently, modding works only in a solo test mode to see if everything works well.  The Steam workshop will open in a few weeks allowing you to create custom servers with your favorite mods !

The modding systemis available on the modding-beta branch in Steam.
Don't hesitate to join [url=https://discord.gg/xRX9aWfrSN]our Discord server[/url] to discuss about mods in the newly created section !

Thank you for playing GangV ! We're really excited to see what you will create ! :)

notes.title: Aggressive Zones
notes.content:
Hello everyone !

Today's update will introduce you to [b][i]Aggressive Zones[/i][/b].
These areas are [b]very[/b] dangerous and hide a [b]large[/b] amount of money, so be prepared!

Here are the aggressive places you can explore:

[list]
[*] The International Airport
[*] The Military Base
[*] The Nuclear Plant
[*] The Prison
[*] The Space Center
[*] The Fourbridge Airport
[*] The Riverside Airport
[*] The Springfox Aerodrome
[/list]

Each of them hides a suitcase filled with cash defended by guards. The longer you stay inside an aggressive zone, the more dangerous it becomes.
They are supposed to be very challenging so be prepared before you set foot on them! 

If you are playing with friends, make sure you are all close to the money when one of you takes it to share it between you ;)

notes.title: FitRun, Seated Mode Ergonomy and Stability Update 27/04/2021
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38336796/ae62e1817e8819b985281b76e86f3d1f4fe22787.png[/img]


You can now use Fit Run (run in place) locomotion if you want to stay fit while playing GangV!

We have also implemented a seated mode allowing you to enjoy fully the game while staying on your chair.

We have enabled multiple options in the controls>option menu to suit better your preferences
such as snap turning, smooth turning, controller oriented movement, etc...

The game stability and performances has also been overall improved!


Changelog :
- Game should now starts correctly in flat or VR mode depending on what has been selected at launch in steam
- Added multiples VR settings
- VR Controls are diplayed in the menu
- Smooth Turn is back
- Controller/Head oriented movement
- FitRun Locomotion
- Seated Mode

notes.title: VR PARKOUR Update 22/04/2021
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38336796/a510f69a3f34b8c577bf15f46ee68affb984b1ff.gif[/img]

VR Users were disadvantaged on some aspects of the game and this update should bring balance in the GangV world!

PRO Locomotion has been greatly improved for easier use of your surroundings as climbable elements and faster vertical navigation.

You can now jump in VR with right joystick/touchpad up (or with the famous Onawa Jump ;) )


This comes of course with multiple bug fixes as well as stability and performance improvements!

Here is the full changelog :
- Add Jump in VR (push the right joystick to the top to jump)
- Reworked PROLocomotion in VR
- Better Calibration in VR
- Network stability improvement
- Fixed explosives sometimes doing too few damages
- Improved frag grenade, more expensive but deadlier
- Fixed a bug where racing minigame was broken after finishing the race once then restarting it
- VR 3rd person view in vehicles should stay aligned now

notes.title: GangV is out in Early Access !
notes.content:
After more than three years of development we are happy to announce that GangV is available in Early Access on Steam!

It has been a long time of hard work but it's only the beginning of our journey! We release it in early access so that we can pursue the game's development with you!

With the Early Access release of GangV we are finally able to bring to you our innovative and experimental gameplay with unique mechanics!

Keep in mind that it is an Early Access and you should expect major bugs.
I you want to help us, please don't hesitate to report the bugs, how you would like the game to evolve and what you liked on our Discord: https://discord.gg/h7yUccT

If you liked the game, please leave us a review, it helps us a lot!

notes.title: The game will be released as Early Access on Steam in two hours !
notes.content:
Hello everyone !

The game will be released in Early Access on Steam in two hours!

Thank you very much to all of you who for participated to the alpha test ! :)

The game has evolved enormously since the first session in June. This is clearly the most ambitious project we have ever carried out and we hope that early access will allow it to go even further. Thank you for your support and we hope this is just the beginning of the story. Here is the trailer of the early access, we hope you like it in any case do not hesitate to give us your opinion. Thank you very much and see you soon
